prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for all homeowners in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your neighborhood, budget, schedule, and the scope/complexity of the job. I can, however, help you pick the best contractor for your situation and point you to ways to quickly find top-rated options.

How to find the best interior painter in St. Louis
- Look at multiple review sources: Google Reviews, Yelp, Angi (Angie’s List), and the Better Business Bureau. Look for consistent high ratings and thoughtful recent reviews with photos.  
- Check credentials: proof of insurance, business license, and (for older homes) lead-safe certification if your home was built before 1978.  
- Portfolio and references: ask for recent before/after photos of similar rooms and at least 3 local references you can contact.  
- Written estimate and scope: get at least 3 detailed written estimates that list prep steps, number of coats, paint brand/finish, trim work, cleanup, and warranty.  
- Warranty & touch-ups: find out what is covered and for how long (look for at least a 1–2 year workmanship guarantee).  
- Prep and protection: confirm they will move/cover furniture, protect floors, fill holes, sand, prime where needed, and remove hardware.  
- Communication and timeline: get a start date, estimated days of work, and a primary contact person.  
- Cost sanity check: interior painting typically ranges widely — small rooms might be $300–$800; whole-home jobs commonly run $2–6 per sq. ft. of wall surface depending on prep and paint quality. Ask what brand and sheen they plan to use.

Where to start in St. Louis
- Search “interior painters near me” on Google and sort by rating; read multiple recent reviews.  
- Check Angi and Yelp for top-rated local companies and compare portfolios and pricing.  
- Ask local Facebook neighborhood groups or Nextdoor for personal referrals — those often yield reliable leads.

Questions to ask a painter during an estimate
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide proof?  
- Are you lead-safe certified? (if applicable)  
- What brand and sheen of paint do you recommend? Are premium paints included in the estimate?  
- How many coats do you include for walls and trim? Do you prime?  
- What prep work is included (patching, sanding, caulking, wallpaper removal)?  
- Who will be on-site and will they be employees or subcontractors?  
- What is the projected start and completion date? What is your payment schedule?  
- Do you offer a warranty or guarantee?

If you’d like, I can:
- Look up the top-rated interior painters in St. Louis and give you a short list (with links to reviews) — tell me your zip code or neighborhood.  
- Provide a sample email/script you can use when requesting estimates.  
- Help compare 2–3 estimates you receive.

Which would you prefer?
